rounds.text: Rudra Gas Enterprise Ltd is severely under-appreciated by the market, trading at a remarkably low P/E of 6.72x and a price-to-book ratio of just 1.40x [E1, E2]. This valuation sits in sharp contrast to the company's elite fundamental performance, which includes a 5-year compounded sales growth of 34% and a 5-year compounded profit growth of 46% [E8, E11]. Profitability metrics are equally compelling, demonstrated by a robust ROE of 23.2% and an ROCE of 22.6%, comfortably outperforming the sector median ROCE of 13.6% [E6, E7, E62]. Furthermore, recent operating results are accelerating, with net profit up 200% year-on-year and a quarterly operating margin expanding to 15% in Mar 2026 [E19, E54, E58]. A reverse DCF implies the market is irrationally pricing in an earnings contraction of -8.0%, defying the company's historical growth trajectory [E33]. Conceded: the stock is down -27.7% over the past year, operates below its 200-day moving average, and faces negative free cash flow of Rs -23 Cr alongside rising borrowings [E14, E24, E27, E36].
